description: Source code for helper functions related to quantization in Torch JIT, including operator lists, pattern matching, module access, and utility functions.

classes.name: FuncArg
classes.description: Structure representing a function argument with function name and argument index.

methods.name: matchAtenFuncToUse
methods.description: Checks if a use matches a specific aten function name and argument position.

methods.name: matchCallFuncToUse
methods.description: Checks if a use matches a specific CallFunction name and argument position.

methods.name: matchArgPattern
methods.description: Checks if a value's uses match specified aten or call function patterns.

methods.name: isWeight
methods.description: Determines if a value is a weight parameter based on pattern matching.

methods.name: isBiasOfConvOrLinear
methods.description: Checks if a value is a bias parameter of convolution or linear layers.

methods.name: isEmbeddingBagNonInput
methods.description: Checks if a value is an embedding bag non-input parameter.

methods.name: getClampScalarInputUse
methods.description: Finds use of a value in clamp operations with scalar inputs.

methods.name: cloneMethod
methods.description: Clones a method within a module with a new name.

methods.name: getPassThroughInputs
methods.description: Retrieves inputs that pass through certain operations.

methods.name: toAtenSymbol
methods.description: Converts a list of function names to aten NodeKind symbols.

methods.name: isAtenFunc
methods.description: Checks if a node is an aten function of specified kinds.

methods.name: isFunctionNode
methods.description: Checks if a node is a function node matching call or aten function lists.

methods.name: isSingleInputGeneralShapeAtenFunction
methods.description: Checks if a node is a specific aten shape function.

methods.name: isSingleInputGeneralValueAtenFunction
methods.description: Checks if a node is a specific aten value function.

methods.name: isSingleInputGeneralCallFunction
methods.description: Checks if a node is a call function with specific pattern.

methods.name: isSingleInputGeneralAtenFunction
methods.description: Checks if a node is a general aten function.

methods.name: isClamp
methods.description: Checks if a node is a clamp operation.

methods.name: isTensorInfoNode
methods.description: Checks if a node retrieves tensor info.

methods.name: isPropagateQuantSingleInputOp
methods.description: Checks if a node is a quantization propagation op for single input.

methods.name: isPropagateQuantBinaryOp
methods.description: Checks if a node is a quantization propagation op for binary ops.

methods.name: isPropagateQuantOp
methods.description: Checks if a node is a quantization propagation op.

methods.name: isBinaryOpWithScalarInput
methods.description: Checks if a node is a binary op with scalar second input.

methods.name: getFixedQParams
methods.description: Retrieves fixed quantization parameters for a node if available.

methods.name: userDefinedCallFunction
methods.description: Checks if a node is a user-defined call function.

methods.name: isWeightOnlyStaticQuantOp
methods.description: Checks if a node is a static quantization op with weight-only parameters.

methods.name: nodeQuantizable
methods.description: Determines if a node is quantizable based on quantization type.

methods.name: useQuantizable
methods.description: Checks if a use is quantizable under a specific quantization type.

methods.name: getCallFunctionGraph
methods.description: Retrieves the graph of a call function node.

methods.name: alwaysRaisesException
methods.description: Checks if a block always raises an exception.

methods.name: isScalar
methods.description: Checks if a value is a scalar (number or 0-dim tensor).

methods.name: hitGraphInput
methods.description: Checks if a value is an input to its owning graph.

methods.name: getModuleAccessPath
methods.description: Retraces module attribute access path for a value.

methods.name: findChildModule
methods.description: Finds a child module given a module and attribute path.

methods.name: getInvokedModule
methods.description: Gets the module invoked by a node, given the parent module and self value.

methods.name: getInvokedModuleOpt
methods.description: Optionally retrieves the invoked module, or null if not found.

methods.name: is_int_constant
methods.description: Checks if a match value is an integer constant with specific value.

methods.description: Removes torch mangling suffix from a name.

methods.description: Retrieves the module name from a value, removing torch mangling.

methods.name: is_module
methods.description: Checks if a value corresponds to a specific module by name.
